# Official tariff fixture: Colombian quota

Retrieved on 15 September 2026 from the UK Integrated Online Tariff:
https://www.trade-tariff.service.gov.uk/uk/api/commodities/7323930010?as_of=2026-09-15&filter%5Bgeographical_area_id%5D=CO

The adjacent JSON retains the complete response, including 361 included
resources. Measure 20050020 is a type-143/preference-320 Colombian quota,
order 057162, linked to definition 26425 and legal act P2114570. Its definition
states kilogram units and a 1 August 2026 to 31 July 2027 period. The displayed
open balance is public reference information, not an allocation to this tenant.

Tests add **synthetic** allocation and origin evidence. No declaration was
submitted and this fixture does not represent a real customer allocation,
Customs-team certification or a returned CDS assessment.
